feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: 4 ways to avoid getting ripped off, according to a pricing expert
entry.summary: Companies have changed the way they price their products — and shoppers are getting deliberately overcharged. Here are steps you can take to ensure you are getting the best deal.

entry.title: As the U.S. signals a smaller Middle East footprint, Turkey is ready to step in
entry.summary: Turkey's bid for regional influence comes as the Middle East has been hit by profound shocks that started with the Hamas-led 2023 attack on Israel and continue with the seven-month-old war on Iran.

entry.title: News organizations ask court to bar White House enforcement of access ban
entry.summary: Three news outlets that President Trump banished from White House grounds asked a federal court to block the ban until the case is resolved.

entry.title: OpenAI delays latest model over security concerns, as industry faces pressure
entry.summary: OpenAI's decision to hold back the model, called GPT-6.1 Astra, comes amid a broader push within the industry to slow the development of increasingly autonomous systems until safety measures catch up.

entry.title: Tennessee is set to execute a woman for the first time in 200 years
entry.summary: One of the youngest women sent to death row is set to be executed in Tennessee. If carried out as scheduled Wednesday, it would be Tennessee's first execution of a woman in 200 years.

entry.title: The Senate passes the Protect College Sports Act, but the bill's future is unclear
entry.summary: The bill's supporters, which include the NCAA, say it will tame what they call a "Wild West" era of college sports as litigation chips away at long-held rules around eligibility, transfers and pay.

entry.title: Kyle MacLachlan says he was David Lynch's 'submersible' into dark places
entry.summary: MacLachlan was 23 when he auditioned for Lynch's adaptation of Dune. The two would go on to work together on the cult classics Blue Velvet and Twin Peaks. MacLachlan's new memoir is Fictional Selves.

entry.title: I didn't think 'Pachinko' could be topped. Then I read 'American Hagwon'
entry.summary: Min Jin Lee's new novel is the third in a planned four-novel series about the Korean diaspora. Nearly 10 years in the making, this sweeping-but-intimate 600+ page book is overwhelming — in a good way.

entry.title: Cornell fraternity rape case is reopened as new details emerge
entry.summary: New York prosecutors are reexamining an investigation into an alleged rape case at Cornell University in 2024. The alleged victim recently filed a lawsuit against seven members of Chi Phi fraternity.

entry.title: Trump's immigration push has largely spared farms. Idaho dairymen worry it won't last.
entry.summary: America's farms have largely escaped the president's aggressive immigration crackdown. But as ICE sweeps continue across the nation, farmers are uneasy because many still can't find enough workers.
